messages.content: Explain products clearly and concisely using only the supplied information.

Describe Mubit in two sentences for a technical founder, focusing on what it learns from and what the team retains control of.

Mubit calibrates agentic runtimes using execution traces and verified outcomes.
Point your model calls at Mubit. It calibrates every call at runtime, then builds and refreshes a dedicated model for each task your agents repeat, switching over only when it does better. Your frontier models stay. You own what's built.
It connects reusable memory, prompt and skill improvements, and task-specific model behavior in a learning loop around your existing agent workflow.

message.content: Mubit learns from your agents’ execution traces and verified outcomes to improve reusable memory, prompts, skills, and task-specific models. Your team keeps its existing workflow and frontier models, owns what Mubit builds, and switches to a dedicated model only when it performs better.
